Across all 48 preset x rate cells, RouteBalance's reduction against RB-decoupled, model against their runs: E2E Pearson 0.89, Spearman 0.92; cost Pearson 0.91, Spearman 0.79. Mean reduction, theirs / model: E2E 9.7% / 11.5%, cost 13.2% / 18.1%.

The sequential design on the shared objective (router scores each model at the balancer's pick, then the balancer picks within the router's model, both on RouteBalance's round-normalised objective; not in the paper) differs from fused RouteBalance by at most 5.5% in E2E and 5.4% in cost over the 48 cells (mean -0.0% and 0.6%).
